text:
Maya K: Quick heads-up — candidate for SRE role is tomorrow 10:30-12:00 PT. Two panelists had to swap; we need coverage for the system-design slot at 11:00. Also: please bring rubric scores to the debrief (12:15 in the calendar). Code test + logs are at https://git.internal/repo/infra-candidate. Can someone pick up 11:00? Also quick question: are we using the 1-4 numeric rubric or 1-5? Thanks.

Samir Patel: I can take 11:00, added to the event. Maya, can you drop the rubric link here?

Jordan R: Rubric link is in Drive: https://drive.company/interviews/rubric. We use 1-4 for competency bits (1 = lacking, 4 = strong). For whiteboard depth, add a note.

Emily Chen: I can be there too. Small ask — do we want the candidate to do the full system-design prompt or the shorter troubleshooting scenario? Resume says infra focus so I'd prefer system-design.

Alex G: I'll paste a tiny debrief template into the calendar description: `Strengths: 
Risks/Concerns: 
Score (1-4) by category: Tech / Design / Communication 
Recommendation: Hire / No Hire / Hire with Concerns` — feel free to tweak.

Samir Patel: Thanks Alex — that template helps. Quick note: candidate asked if we can allow 10 extra minutes for setup (VPN + repo access). Is that okay?

Maya K: Yeah giving an extra 10 mins at start is fine — added 10-min buffer to calendar. Samir please confirm VPN instructions are in the invite.

Jordan R: Confirmed re: rubric scale (1-4). For borderline, mark comments clearly — helps debrief.

InterviewBot: Reminder set — debrief reminder 10 minutes after last interview. Calendar event updated and attendees notified. :bell:

Maya K: Awesome, thanks everyone. Samir — can you nudge the candidate to confirm Zoom + VPN? Emily/Jordan/Alex — see you tomorrow. If anyone needs to swap, ping here and I'll handle. :thumbsup:
